A useful first conversation
  • Your goals and what matters most
  • The people who will use it
  • The right starting point
  • Scope, timing and next steps
A few things you might be wondering.
Can we start with a small project?
Yes. A focused website, prototype or integration is often the right place to start. The scope can grow as the direction becomes clearer.
Can you work with our existing systems?
We begin by reviewing your current setup, access and integration options, then recommend a practical path forward.
Who owns the code and design?
Ownership, licences and handover are agreed in the project scope before work begins, so responsibilities are clear from the start.
What happens after launch?
We can define an ongoing support plan covering maintenance, hosting and future improvements according to your needs.
